read.en: MP Materials rose 4.2% on Oct 15 to $41.61, closing near the day's high after trading as low as $38.60. It remains below all its falling averages: the 5-day ($42.7), 10-day ($44.8), 30-day ($48.2), 100-day ($52.5) and 200-day ($56.3). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($47.7), and RSI is 35, back out of oversold.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月15日上涨 4.2%，收于 $41.61，盘中最低下探 $38.60 后收在当日高位附近。股价仍位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$42.7）、10 日（$44.8）、30 日（$48.2）、100 日（$52.5）和 200 日（$56.3）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$47.7），RSI 为 35，已脱离超卖区。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $40 round number, now support, and the Jul 29 52-week low of $37.81 held. Resistance is $42.4–42.7 (Oct 13 close, 5-day average), then $44.5–44.8 (Oct 1 low, 10-day average) and $47.3–47.7 (Sep 18 low, SAR). Support is $40, then $37.8 and $35. A close above $42.7 would open $44.5–44.8; a close below $37.8 would set a new 52-week low.
read.zh: 收盘收复 $40 整数关口，该位置重新转为支撑，7月29日的 52 周低点 $37.81 守住。阻力为 $42.4–42.7（10月13日收盘价、5 日均线），其次 $44.5–44.8（10月1日低点、10 日均线）和 $47.3–47.7（9月18日低点、SAR）。支撑为 $40，其次 $37.8 和 $35。若收盘站上 $42.7，将打开至 $44.5–44.8 的空间；若收盘跌破 $37.8，将创 52 周新低。
